title: Memory safety bugs fixed in Thunderbird ESR 140.10.1 and Thunderbird 150.0.1
description: Memory safety bugs have been identified and fixed in Thunderbird ESR 140.10.1 and Thunderbird 150.0.1. These bugs relate to improper handling of memory, which can lead to potential security vulnerabilities. The specific vulnerability is tracked as CVE-2026-7323 and is associated with CWE-119, indicating a classic memory safety issue such as buffer overflows or similar. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and no known exploits are reported in the wild.
